d:
The 76ers defeated the Bulls, 127-121 tonight in Chicago. Jaylen Brown contributed a team-high 29 points to go with 7 rebounds 4 assists and 2 three pointers, with Tyrese Maxey of the 76ers adding an additional 27 points (9-16 FG, 3-7 3P) in the game. Josh Giddey finished with a team-high 19 points along with 15 assists for the Bulls in the losing effort. The 76ers improve their record to 9-2 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 1-8 for the season.
